description.value: Adrienne's Restaurant & Tea Garden is a full-service restaurant and tea room set within the historic Mattick's Farm market on Cordova Bay Road, a property with roots going back to a roadside farm stand opened in 1957. It serves breakfast, lunch, and afternoon High Tea alongside an in-house bakery, deli counter, and ice cream parlour. The farm setting, locally-sourced and ocean-wise ingredients, and explicitly wheelchair-accessible premises make it a distinctive destination on a Saanich Peninsula cycling route.
